description: Institution-level data from the College Scorecard, covering aggregate data for each U.S. higher education institution. Includes information on institutional characteristics, enrollment, student aid, costs, admission rates, test scores, completion/graduation rates, student debt, and post-graduation earnings.
data_vintage: April 2023 release (Most Recent Cohorts through 2020-21 academic year)
years_covered: 1996-97 through 2020-21 (varies by metric; 'Most Recent' aggregates latest available)

Most-Recent-Cohorts-Institution.csv.description: Full institution-level dataset with all 2,989 columns

scorecard-key-fields.csv.description: Extract of 44 key analysis fields (admissions, costs, outcomes, demographics)

scorecard-api-latest.csv.description: Latest data fetched via College Scorecard API (may be more current than bulk file)
scorecard-api-latest.csv.note: Generated by fetch_api_data.py script; may need to re-run if not yet present

key_fields.SAT_AVG: Average SAT equivalent score (combined reading + math)
key_fields.PCTPELL: Percentage of students receiving Pell grants
key_fields.RET_FT4: First-time full-time student retention rate (4-year institutions)

notes: The official bulk download at ed-public-download.app.cloud.gov is currently offline (cloud.gov route not found as of March 2026).
Data was sourced from Zenodo mirror (UC Berkeley copy) of the official April 2023 release.
The College Scorecard API (api.data.gov) provides more current data but requires pagination and has rate limits (1000 req/hr with DEMO_KEY).
Many fields use 'NULL' or 'PrivacySuppressed' for missing/suppressed values.
Not all institutions report all metrics; coverage varies significantly by field type.
The API 'latest' endpoint pulls the most recent data available for each metric, which may span different years.
